controls.name: C-21d
controls.query:
FROM logs-nginx.access-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-06-30T06:17:32.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-07T06:17:32.000Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| STATS requests = COUNT(*)
        BY http.response.status_code
| SORT requests DESC
